build_baseline: run #6 = 4ba22b9 (3 h, exit experiment): A +248.61 RUB / +1.49 per trade, B -375.35 / -2.27, paired B-A -4.24, CI [-19.2, +10.7]
entry_fill_price: the first on-chain curve read after detection (the same getMultipleAccounts context that passed the security filters). The WSS packet price is never used for a fill; entry_lag_ms records how old the read was and entry_premium_pct compares the entry mid with the coin t0 mid of that read
exit_rule: fee cover: hard stop −10%, sell 100% at +3.5%, else time exit 5s; no TP1, no trail, no shelf, no no-progress
run8_design: S1 = B1 verbatim (birth 30.50-34.50, delta 0.10-1.00); S0 = S1 with the momentum gate removed (delta_min 0.00). Both books carry one exit: hard stop -10%, sell 100% at +3.5%, else the 5 s clock. No reference arm A in this run, so S0 is compared with S1 and nothing is compared with A.
run8_why_fee_cover: the replay of run #7's 167 real B1 trades, priced from observations and net of the measured 3.25% round trip: B1 + fee-cover 3.5% = -4.93%; B1 held to 5 s = -2.22%; the whole t0 band + 5 s + stop -10% = +1.46% (n=1533). Median entry premium: B1 2.89%, A 5.55%, B3 0.00% — delta >= 0.10 buys somebody else's move and then sells it at +3.5%.
run8_out_of_scope: no money verdict: 30-60 trades per book cannot resolve anything. The replay expects about -4.9% for S1 and -4.6% for S0, the best measured variant about +1%; what this run measures is latency, execution cost and whether fee_cover fires at all. No comparison with A, no better/worse claim.
run8_acceptance: paper_only=true and 0 signed; duration >= 1790 s; early_stop_reason = null; unrecovered RPC errors <= 2%; mean rps <= 1.8 and worst 10-min window <= 2.2 (or the 0.25 s cadence adaptation recorded); dropped_events = 0; write_errors = 0; 0 open positions at the end; fee_cover fired at least once in each book; t_total_ms median recorded without a threshold
run8_latency_chain: t_detect_ms WSS packet -> candidate row; t_filters_ms candidate row -> security verdict; t_read_ms verdict -> the curve read the fill is priced from (0 when the filter batch IS that read); t_fill_ms read -> fill row; t_total_ms packet -> fill row
run8_mark_poll: MARK_POLL_SEC default 0.15 s (floor 0.05); if a 10-min window passes 2.2 rps the cadence rises to 0.25 s once and mark_poll_adapted=true is reported. accountSubscribe is not used: a second mark source would make exit timing depend on which stream arrived first

portfolio_b1_narrow.why: the only band with non-negative EV at 5-10 s in all three runs (+0.47/+1.42/+1.82 %), and better on the real ladder in run3/run5 (-11.1/-7.2 vs -23.7/-20.1); risk: three rockets carried the 1-2.5 band in run6

portfolio_b2_birth.why: the only filter with a stable sign 4/4 on a fixed exit, and identical to dev_buy <= 1 SOL; risk: on the run6 ladder it lost (-507 RUB vs +755 RUB for birth > 31)

portfolio_s0.role: run #8 control: same band as S1 minus the momentum gate

portfolio_b3_t0.why: the only arm whose expected gain is arithmetic: it enters on the first curve read (A waits for a 0.10 SOL impulse) and so does not pay the measured 1.416 % entry_fill_premium (~7 RUB on 500 RUB); it also sees 438 coins instead of 167 inside the same birth band, with the same 6.6 % rocket share (60 s window). Risk: entering without an impulse confirmation

run7_expectation.portfolio_b1_narrow: +1..+6 RUB/trade vs A (better in 3/3 runs on a fixed exit and in run3/run5 on the ladder; the narrow band cuts the flow 1.8x)
run7_expectation.portfolio_b2_birth: -8..+8 RUB (model says better in 2/3 runs, the run6 ladder lost 15.7 RUB/trade: the run decides)
run7_expectation.portfolio_b3_t0: +3..+9 RUB from removing the 1.416 % entry premium (~7 RUB on 500 RUB); EV itself is neutral

run7_decision_rule: an arm confirms its hypothesis iff the PAIRED mean(arm - A) >= +8 RUB on the coins both arms traded, the 98.75 % bootstrap CI (Bonferroni over three hypotheses, alpha 0.0125) excludes 0, and the sign is the same in both halves of the run
run7_power: paired sd ~98 RUB, ~56 trades/hour per arm: the CI half width is ~15 RUB at ~165 pairs, so a 3-hour run cannot resolve anything below ~15 RUB/trade, and the +8 RUB threshold needs ~1 700 pairs after Bonferroni, i.e. ~21 h at this flow
run7_p0_accepted: early_stop_reason = null, unrecovered RPC failures <= 2 %, dropped_events = 0, write_errors = 0, requests_per_sec <= 1.8, security_fail_skipped_deep > 0, no shadow profiles, enrich.csv written
run7_p0_fixes: P0-2 verdict resolved inside the offset loop (run6 read every offset because the verdict was set after observe_candidate); ticks carry price_usd instead of a rouble price divided by sol_usd; security_fail_reasons use the LAST reason (the verdict, not the passed check); ticks gain mark_prev_pct/step_gap_pp/mark_gap_ms and exit_kind; observation offsets 0/5/15/60, with the 60 s read taken for a hash-selected third of the coins; entry_lag_ms replaces the "floor violations" counter that measured the model, not a failure
run7_not_doing: no exit change in any arm, no delta > 2.5 arm (EV@15 -9.25/-5.84/-5.54 % in three runs and no extra rockets inside A's birth band), no creator gate live (worse than average in 4/4 samples), no fourth experimental arm, no band tuning mid-run
bank_rule: каждый профиль ведёт свой кэш; если перед входом cash < 500 ₽, книга пополняется до 1500 ₽ и сделка открывается. Ставка 500 ₽, 3 слота и все входы/выходы не меняются — пополнение влияет только на «торговать / не торговать». Счётчик top_ups остаётся метрикой
stop_list: прогон останавливается только по четырём причинам: telemetry dropped_events/write_errors > 0; доля НЕИСПРАВЛЕННЫХ ошибок RPC (после 3 ретраев 0.2/0.5/1.2 c + джиттер, с учётом Retry-After) > 2% за 10 мин или p95 > 1000 мс пять минут подряд; профиль без входов 30 мин при растущем entry_state; остаток квоты Helius < 10% или < 2 ГБ на диске. Порог 2% поднимать запрещено. PnL не является причиной остановки

portfolio_s0.bank_rule: каждый профиль ведёт свой кэш; если перед входом cash < 500 ₽, книга пополняется до 1500 ₽ и сделка открывается. Ставка 500 ₽, 3 слота и все входы/выходы не меняются — пополнение влияет только на «торговать / не торговать». Счётчик top_ups остаётся метрикой
portfolio_s0.stop_list: прогон останавливается только по четырём причинам: telemetry dropped_events/write_errors > 0; доля НЕИСПРАВЛЕННЫХ ошибок RPC (после 3 ретраев 0.2/0.5/1.2 c + джиттер, с учётом Retry-After) > 2% за 10 мин или p95 > 1000 мс пять минут подряд; профиль без входов 30 мин при растущем entry_state; остаток квоты Helius < 10% или < 2 ГБ на диске. Порог 2% поднимать запрещено. PnL не является причиной остановки
